{{Quote|So you guys are like Gell'ach going into Kabal&ndash; or Revan before... what was it? Garr'lst? No, Cathar. I get my massacred cat people mixed up.|[[Jarrow Rusher]], to [[Kerra Holt]]|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
'''Garr'lst''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Members of the planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Unidentified Garr'lst species|feline species]] were massacred at some point before or during the [[Republic Dark Age]].
